description: This header file declares internal URL parsing functions used within the cURL project, including functions to evaluate absolute URLs and set URL authority components. It also includes conditional debugging functions.

methods.name: Curl_is_absolute_url
methods.description: Checks if a given URL is absolute, with an optional buffer for scheme guessing.

methods.name: Curl_url_set_authority
methods.description: Sets the authority component of a URL object.

methods.name: Curl_parse_port
methods.description: Parses and assigns port information to a URL object, included only in debug builds.
